description:
[Market] Where to sell Rust skins: the best cash payout per skin. The table on rust.wiki/skins/where-to-sell: for each skin, the best instant cash offer across the tracked
marketplaces (buy orders and site buybacks), after the site's seller fee. Each row: `itemdefid`, `name`,
`category`, `venue`/`venue_label` and `url` of the best cash offer, `gross` and `net` (cents, before/after the
fee), `buyback` (the site buys it itself), `count` (how many it will take), `steam_net` (what selling on Steam
leaves in your Steam wallet after its 15% fee - wallet money, not cash), `list_venue`/`list_net` (the best
estimate for listing it and waiting) and `offers` (how many venues bid). Rebuilt with every marketplace poll. Best CASH payout per skin across marketplaces (Steam pays wallet money only). For one skin use get_skin_sell_options.

min_payout.description: Only skins paying at least this many US DOLLARS after fees.

sort.description: `payout` = highest cash payout first; `cheap` = lowest; `steam` = biggest gap where Steam (wallet money) pays more than cash; `name`.

venue.description: Only skins whose best cash offer is on this marketplace (a `venue` value from the results).

name: find_where_to_sell
title: Where to sell Rust skins: the best cash payout per skin
